title: Separate public vocabulary payloads from repository work and release controls
summary: Public native packages retain their vocabulary, implementations and teaching assets while repository work and neutral examples use separate authored and fixture corpora. Exact root release controls preserve installed distribution identities without coupling every vocabulary package; archives using this source profile require an updated consumer, while previous archives and engine locks remain supported. Qualification compares the actual packed dependency cycle groups with the maintained policy. Workspace composition accepts system references only; repository qualification rejects copied active npm versions and package counts while retaining version-pinned historical decisions.
